Builddrone 0.6.3 publishes documentation by committing the versioned site to
`gh-pages`. GitHub Pages deploys that branch. The docs job no longer uploads
a Pages artifact.

**Documentation:** https://nepitwin.github.io/Builddrone/latest/

---

## Publishing

### Documentation is committed to `gh-pages`

The Docs workflow still runs after a successful PyPI publish. `mike` builds
the new release onto the existing `gh-pages` history and the workflow pushes
that commit.

Older versions stay on the branch. GitHub's pages build deploys the branch
tip, so the published site keeps every version.

In the repository Pages settings, set the source to **Deploy from a branch**
and select `gh-pages`.
